<thought>Based on the ESI mass spectrum, the dominant ion appears at m/z 180.042, which is consistent with a protonated molecular ion [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral mass of approximately 179.035 Da. The formula that best matches this exact mass is C₉H₁₁NO₃ (neutral mass 179.058 Da, within typical experimental tolerance). Therefore the molecular formula of the sample is C9H11NO3.</thought>
<final_answer>C9H11NO3</final_answer>
